journey.name: Allgemein · Lernweg
journey.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: calm, professional full-screen background for an offline classroom lesson app, landscape 16:9. Create a brand-new high-quality raster illustration. Mature restrained painterly paper-cut shapes, low contrast, softly blurred distant layers, desaturated sage, mist blue, warm cream, subtle light. A very large quiet pale open center and upper half where high-contrast white lesson cards will be overlaid. Scenic forms are mostly along the bottom and far outer edges. The result should be restful to the eyes, not busy or childish. No characters, text, letters, UI, icons, signage, cards, border, logos or watermarks. No strong gradients or neon. No large central objects. Theme: learning as a journey. Spacious pale ivory sky above gently layered sage green and blue hills, a delicate winding trail in the lower third. A single rounded tree silhouette at the far left, distant faint mountains at the right. Extremely simple, serene, adult educational visual, restrained illustration.

care.name: FaGe · Pflegeweg

emergency.name: Notfälle · Ambulanz CH
emergency.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: themed background for a Swiss adult vocational healthcare classroom app, wide landscape 16:9. Quiet mature soft paper-cut / painterly illustration, low contrast, desaturated sage, pale mist blue, warm ivory, subtle restrained high-visibility yellow and coral only on a vehicle. NOT a landscape. Scene is a spacious modern Swiss ambulance station interior / forecourt, light clean walls, an unobtrusive broad route line on the floor linking the space. At the FAR LEFT / lower left a clearly recognizable modern European Mercedes Sprinter-style box-body rescue ambulance with a tall rectangular patient compartment, white and restrained yellow high-visibility panels and a small blue roof light, seen in three-quarter front view, stationary. Use Swiss rescue fleet context, reference: official Stadt Zürich Schutz & Rettung 2025 Rettungswagen RTW Mercedes-Benz Sprinter 519 CDI vehicle page https://www.stadt-zuerich.ch/artikel/de/fuhrpark-schutz-und-rettung/fahrzeuge-sanitaet/Rettungswagen.html . Do not reproduce organization logos or invent labels. No American ambulance truck. Main CENTER and UPPER TWO THIRDS are very quiet pale open wall/space to place lesson cards and a clock; vehicle and a few small garage elements sit along the outer edges and bottom only. No people, patients, medical procedures, text, numerals, logos, Swiss-cross medical badges, UI or card frames. Calm and clearly about emergency services rather than nature.

A modern tidy Swiss long-term-care room / care-learning environment: a simple care bed with pale blue blanket and modest wooden bedside table toward the FAR RIGHT and lower right, a comfortable chair and washbasin area toward the FAR LEFT, gentle curved floor pathway connecting the spaces, a few very restrained practical details. No person, no medical intervention, no instructions. The central60% and upper half are almost empty pale light wall with subtle texture, to overlay large lesson cards.
